_comment: Orientation golden set — the regression suite for answer USEFULNESS rather than groundedness. These are the questions a newcomer actually asks: broad, no jargon, wanting a way in. The first is the verbatim question that prompted the answer-quality overhaul; its original answer was a hedged tour of the retrieval set that defined no terms and led with no substance, while scoring ~1.0 on citation validity. supporting_chunk_ids/source_ids are intentionally empty — this set measures answer shape, not retrieval recall, and recall_at_k returns 1.0 for an empty gold set. Fill them in only if you also want recall measured. asker_level and question_type are what the helpfulness judge holds the answer to.
